crime: During evening free time, {WITCH_NAME} and the woman assigned to the solo cell met there after difficult encounters with the group. Each woman listened while the other spoke about fears and shame that neither would reveal in public.

After a pool game, {WITCH_NAME} admitted that her opponent's angry voice had frightened her into counting a disputed shot. She alone awarded the winning point; when the score was settled, the confidante stayed beside her and supported her decision.

On a later evening, the pool opponent came to the solo cell and rejected the victory she had been given after her outburst. The pool opponent accused the confidante of helping {WITCH_NAME} rig the result in the pool opponent's favor. The confidante disclosed the witch's private admission, explaining that she had learned the reason only after the score was settled and had played no part in the decision. The witch agreed that the disputed shot should not have counted, apologized first, and said the fault was hers. The confidante said she would reveal other resentments shared in private whenever she thought keeping the peace required it. When the witch asked her not to repeat their conversations, the confidante became angry. The witch placed a palm on the confidante's upper back as if trying to calm her.

When it was time for the prisoners to remain in their cells, {WITCH_NAME} and the pool opponent left together. The pool opponent saw a guard lock the confidante alone in the solo cell, and the confidante struck the bars. After the witch was locked in her assigned cell, she could still hear the strikes.

When the solo cell opened, the confidante lay dead beside its barred door. Matching bar-shaped injuries marked the back of the head and upper body; one bar at upper-back height bowed outward into the corridor.

The matching injuries and the outward-bowed bar proved that the confidante had been hurled upright and back-first into the door with force beyond any unaided fall or jump. Nothing in the cell could have launched her. The pool opponent had witnessed {WITCH_NAME} touch the confidante when her anger rose. The strikes that continued after the witch was locked in her assigned cell told the witch that the confidante was still at the bars. From that cell, the witch released the anger she had captured with the touch. Rage Banishment turned the confidante's back toward the nearest doorway, held her rigid and upright, and hurled her back-first into the barred door with inhuman, bone-breaking force, killing her.
fields.epitaph: Her last apology vanished between angry teeth.
execution: An oversized iron mouth faces her while the apparatus holds her upright before its open jaws. Two angry voices argue from inside the mouth: one demands that she admit her fear, while the other condemns the admission. The mouth advances without stopping as she agrees with both voices, apologizes, and accepts the blame. Its teeth catch her shoulders and ribs as the jaws snap shut around her chest and neck. The jaws continue to crush her until she dies, then remain shut.

magic.name: Rage Banishment
magic.text: A touch lets her store someone's anger and later release it as a force that hurls them away.
